name: Game no Sekai ni Bakemono to Shite Tensei Shita Ken ni Tsukimashite.
original_name: ゲームの世界にバケモノとして転生した件につきまして。
source:
The only thing that washes away the daily stress of your factory job is that of MMORPGs.
Taking control of that carefully-sculpted and ideal girl fills you with life.
While playing the game...you fall asleep, and suddenly awaken in the starter dungeon!
And you're a tentacle monster!
Then, that ideal girl you spent hours customizing appears before you!
It's time to put your newfound tentacle powers to the test!
You're a tentacle monster, after all; it'd be rude NOT to violate her.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ313734.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
每天在工厂工作的压力，只有MMORPG才能帮你排解。
操纵那位精心塑造、完全符合自己理想的女孩，便让你重新充满活力。
玩着玩着，你睡着了，再醒来时，竟身处新手地下城！
而且，你还变成了触手怪！
随后，那位花费你数小时自定义出来的理想女孩，出现在了眼前！
是时候试试新得到的触手能力了！
毕竟，身为触手怪，你竟觉得不侵犯她反而有失礼数。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ313734.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英文介绍[/url]]
